hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' 2>/dev/null); d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/docker-compose.yml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/docker-compose.yml" ] && cd "$d" && docker-compose build --no-cache 2>&1 | tail -5 && docker-compose up -d 2>&1 || true
